definitions.rationale: Base equation defining the stringsOnly predicate on the empty ValSeq.
Recursive equation defining stringsOnly on a cons by testing the head and recursing on the tail.
definitions.text:
rule stringsOnly(vCons(V:Val, REST:ValSeq))
    => isStrV(V) andBool stringsOnly(REST)

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining scanEven to return its accumulator when the remaining input is empty.
Guarded recursive defining equation for scanEven that appends an even-length string head and consumes the tail; simplification is used as evaluator metadata for this definition.
definitions.text:
rule scanEven(ACC:ValSeq, vCons(V:Val, REST:ValSeq))
    => scanEven(
         valSeqConcat(ACC, vCons(V, .ValSeq)),
         REST)
    requires isStrV(V)
     andBool pyMod(seqLen(V), 2) ==Int 0
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Guarded recursive defining equation for scanEven that skips an odd-length string head and consumes the tail; simplification is used as evaluator metadata for this definition.
definitions.text:
rule scanEven(ACC:ValSeq, vCons(V:Val, REST:ValSeq))
    => scanEven(ACC, REST)
    requires isStrV(V)
     andBool pyMod(seqLen(V), 2) =/=Int 0
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Totalizing recursive equation defining scanEven on a non-string head by skipping that head and consuming the tail.
definitions.text:
rule scanEven(ACC:ValSeq, vCons(V:Val, REST:ValSeq))
    => scanEven(ACC, REST)
    requires notBool isStrV(V)

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named sortedListSumBody proof term as the exact translated function body.
definitions.text:
rule sortedListSumBody
    => Assign(Name("result"), ListExpr(.Exprs))
       Assign(Name("word"), Str(""))
       For(
         Name("word"),
         Name("lst"),
         If(
           Compare(
             BinOp("%", Call(Name("len"), Name("word")), Int(2)),
             CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
           Expr(
             Call(
               Attribute(Name("result"), "append"),
               Name("word"))),
           .Stmts))
       Return(
         Call(
           Name("sorted"),
           Call(Name("sorted"), Name("result")),
           KwArg("key", Name("len"))))

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining sortedListSumModule from the named function body and entry-point signature.
definitions.text:
rule sortedListSumModule
    => Module(
         FuncDef(
           "sorted_list_sum",
           Params("lst"),
           sortedListSumBody))

source_rules.rationale: Additional trusted definedness fact asserting that seqLen(V) is defined whenever isStrV(V) holds; Stage 1 compiles this simplification before all proofs and contains no prior proof of its exact statement in a module without the rule.
